main.description: P16 step 7 of com.etzhayyim.apps.mangaka.composeCharacterVrm. Headless Blender (`--background --python`) on the VKE CPU pool runs the saturday06 VRM Add-on to take the rigged glTF + blendshape pack + spring-bone hints derived from `profile.gh:hair` and emit a VRM 1.0 binary. ARKit blendshape names are mapped onto VRM Expression presets. Self-hosted on `ghcr.io/etzhayyim/blender-vrm:4.1` (no external API). ADR-2605082000 §2 — kind='mcp_tool'. SSoT: lg_mangaka.tools:tool_bind_vrm.

profile.description: gh:appearance / gh:background — drives spring-bone hints (hair, skirt) and VRM meta (charmName etc.).
